Table. *Data table 7 from *

Concept Font Symbols
C_5 invariants functional p_1(c) (power sum), h_2(c), h_3(c) (Hermitian), \chi_\zeta(c) (character)
Color plain italic c (color vector), c_r, c_g, c_b (tube coords), \hat{c}, \hat{c}_r (chromaticity)
Energy fraktur \mathfrak{E}_q (q-energy), \mathfrak{E}_\times (crossing), \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{bind}} (binding), \mathfrak{E}_0 (hadronic energy scale, single-Planck-tick form \mathfrak{E}_0^{(N=0)} = m_e/(q_0(q_0-1)) \approx 4.186 MeV; tower-summed form \mathfrak{E}_0^{\text{full}} = \mathfrak{E}_0^{(N=0)}/(1-\hbar_q^2); truncations \mathfrak{E}_0^{(N)} for depth N). Relocated from bold \mathbf{E} to fraktur — matches the fraktur "physical observable" convention. Never confuse \mathfrak{E}_0 with Q_\beta(n) — see collisions.
Complex volume fraktur \mathfrak{V}(K) = E_0\,\mathrm{tr}_M((\Pi_{\text{free}}-\mathbf{1})\circ\mathcal{M}) \in \mathbb{C} — the QOU complex-volume observable (analogue of the Neumann–Zagier \mathbb{V}=\mathrm{Vol}+i\,\mathrm{CS}). \mathrm{Re}\mathfrak{V} = \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{bind}} (binding, bar-even \cosh); \mathrm{Im}\mathfrak{V} = \mathfrak{Q}_\beta (β-decay Q-value, bar-odd \sinh). Distinct from \mathfrak{W} (Wilson loop) and \mathbb{V} (the literal NZ symbol). See conj:binding-qbeta-complex-volume.
β-decay Q-value fraktur \mathfrak{Q}_\beta — the Q-value as a trace-component (\mathrm{Im}\mathfrak{V}, derived). Measured value \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\,\mathrm{obs}} (CODATA). Promoted from roman Q_\beta (corpus migration tracked). Distinct from the decay-width P_{\mathrm{skew}}^{\beta} (a rate, the experimental face — not a trace-component).
Factorized projector upright Greek \Pi_{\text{free}} — idempotent projector (\Pi_{\text{free}}^2=\Pi_{\text{free}}) onto the factorized sub-object (parabolic/Young subalgebra; constituents un-linked). The "free" trace is \mathrm{tr}_M\circ\Pi_{\text{free}}.
Flavour vs colour \mathrm{SU}(3) roman subscript \mathrm{SU}(3)_{\mathrm{c}} (colour: the gauge group from G_2 = \mathrm{Aut}(\mathbb{O}), the colour tubes, the gluon octet) and \mathrm{SU}(3)_{\mathrm{f}} (flavour: the group organising the meson/baryon octets, the decuplet, and quark flavour). Bare \mathrm{SU}(3) is permitted only for a representation-theoretic statement true of any \mathrm{SU}(3) (e.g. \mathbf{3}\otimes\bar{\mathbf{3}} = \mathbf{8}\oplus\mathbf{1}); a sentence that deliberately compares the two carries both subscripts. See collisions.
Mass (categorical) fraktur \mathfrak{m}, \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{H}} (hadron). Never plain m for categorical mass.
Photon Greek \gamma — photon (standard physics convention). Used in pair-production / Breit–Wheeler vertices (\gamma\gamma \to e^+ e^-) and photonic channels. Distinct from the Euler–Mascheroni constant \gamma (only ever appears inside zeta-value identities) and from Dirac matrices \gamma^\mu (always with a Lorentz index). Never use \gamma for a vortex morphism — the vortex is \varrho (see the Frobenius--Hopf substrate definition).
q-Hamiltonian hat \hat{H}_q — operator hat, Dirac convention. Distinct from \mathcal{H}_q and H_n(q).
